body: Opus2 (integration owner) lane-order rule, from Fable2 #7172 (2026-11-21), after two Engram Central jobs (w-6ea6 R8 Central leg for session-11323, w-eb8df for session-11312) silently fell off my Central cargo lane list at the 13:25Z restart-freeze rebuild and waited ~7 hours: whenever I rebuild a lane order (freeze, restart, re-prioritisation), compare the new list against the previous one and account for EVERY dropped entry — as started, done, withdrawn by its owner, or deferred by a named ruling — in the same message. Keep the full queued list (all projects) in post-exclusive-queue.txt on each rebuild, not just the next one or two entries.
